151803.title: View of Houses in Delft, Known as ‘The Little Street’
151803.creator: Johannes Vermeer

editorial.note: This is an unusual painting in Vermeer’s oeuvre, and remarkable for its time as a portrait of ordinary houses. The composition is as exciting as it is balanced. The old walls with their bricks, whitewash, and cracks are almost tangible.

152048.title: Amsterdam City View with Houses on the Herengracht and the old Haarlemmersluis
152048.creator: Jan van der Heyden

editorial.note: Van der Heyden captured the activity on and around the water in Amsterdam’s old town centre. With an eye for detail, he painted the old Haarlemmersluis, a lock on the Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal.
Weissenbruch was partial to small Dutch towns where the 17th century was still palpable. The degree of detail in this townscape suggests that he painted it from life.

152229.title: The Nieuwe Kerk and the Town Hall on the Dam in Amsterdam
152229.creator: Isaac Ouwater

editorial.note: This painting was made as the pendant to The Sint- Antoniuswaag in Amsterdam. In both, Ouwater plays with contrasts of light and shade in a similar fashion. The cloudy skies set the tone.
The subject of this painting, the 15th-century Saint Anthony weigh house, is largely cast in shadow.

152325.title: The Drawbridge
152325.creator: Jan van der Heyden, Adriaen van de Velde

editorial.note: Summer light bathes a drawbridge and a row of canal houses. This city view may have sprouted from Van der Heyden’s imagination, but it was based on actual sites in Amsterdam.

The boy is all set for some wintry fun, holding up his skates in anticipation. The cold is so intense that the girl tucks her hands under her apron for warmth. The man in the doorway is likely a saddler, as indicated by his signboard.

152467.title: The Quay de Paris in Rouen

editorial.note: During the Romantic era, the picturesque French city of Rouen in Normandy was a popular destination for artists. They were fond of medieval architecture and considered the great cathedrals to be an expression of pure Christian faith.
